summary.text: Josh Keyser is a Republican who represents District 20 in the Idaho Senate and is listed in a first term; the directory lists Keyser as a businessman.

paragraphs.text: According to the legislature's biography, Keyser holds a B.A. in business from Vanguard University and works as a financial auditor.
It lists Keyser as a former U.S. Marine, Boise police officer, and vice principal of the Vineyard Christian Academy, and as a member of the Cherokee Nation.
